dialogues.speaker: Denichere
dialogues.text: This Gardemek. Heinry says it's the Motorized Autonomous Fonta Vending Machine's bodyguard. He even tried to install a recording device in it...

dialogues.speaker: Denichere
dialogues.text: But he should stick to making Fonta, it's all he's good at. I'm the only one who knows how to fix things.
